Title: April 23, 2026 City of Boulder City Council Study Session

Topic1.Title: Future of Boulder Municipal Airport and Land Use Options
Topic1.Summary: Staff presented updates on the airport's finances, the closed FAA litigation, and community input from the 2023 airport community conversation. Staff asked council whether to support Scenario 1, indefinite operation of the airport, or Scenario 2, maintaining the closure opportunity by forgoing federal grants until 2040. Council members raised concerns about perpetual grant assurances, operating costs, noise, lead fuel, and the lack of public hearing for such a consequential decision. In a straw poll, five members favored Scenario 1 and four favored Scenario 2, and staff was directed to bring back formal action to document the direction.

Topic2.Title: Power Resilience and Reliability Update
Topic2.Summary: Staff reported that Excel Energy's public safety power shutoffs and aging infrastructure have led to more frequent and longer outages affecting Boulder residents. Staff outlined the city's advocacy at the Public Utilities Commission, the legislature, and in Excel's rate case, along with the development of risk zones and outcome metrics. The proposed plan includes a phased community engagement process this summer and fall, a community and council forum, and an Excel study session in August. Council generally supported the proposed approach, and members asked for stronger accountability, attention to relocation and vulnerable populations, cost information before budget season, and more precise engagement with different community segments.
